# Lingroo

Lingroo is an independent German B2/C1 learning web app and PWA. It is designed for short daily practice and exam-oriented preparation. It is not affiliated with telc, Goethe-Institut or TestDaF.

## Current offer
- Soft-launch Premium price: EUR 4.99 per month
- Full tester access: 14 days after registration
- Monthly cancellation
- Main app interface: German
- Vocabulary support: Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and English
- Speaking practice: in development, not yet a finished core feature

## Verified current content inventory
- Vocabulary: 997 entries (298 B2, 699 C1)
- Context synonym tasks: 750 (250 B2, 500 C1)
- Gap and structure tasks: 320 counted items (150 B2 single-gap tasks, 150 gaps in 30 B2 texts, 20 C1 structure tasks)
- Reading: 80 texts (30 B2, 50 C1) with 450 questions
- Listening: 40 primary items (15 B2, 25 C1) with 200 questions
- Writing topics: 30 (15 B2, 15 C1)
- Short writing exercises: 14 (6 B2, 8 C1)
- Exam Mode: 6 original training packs (3 B2, 3 C1)

## Access logic
Without Premium, the current C1 app logic allows a limited sample, including 5 listening items, 5 reading texts, 1 writing topic, 200 vocabulary entries and 100 synonym tasks. Tester and Premium plans unlock full access.
